articles.summary: Diallo may have candidacy confirmed by Uefa on Tuesday Uefa executive committee meeting to discuss matter The French Football Federation president, Philippe Diallo, is a surprise late contender to run for the Fifa presidency and could have his candidacy confirmed by Tuesday. The search for a Uefa-backed candidate to run against Gianni Infantino has been taken to the wire, with Wednesday the deadline for those planning to contest the Fifa election in March. Diallo has emerged as the favourite to be put forward after plans to enlist a decorated former player or manager did not reach fruition, although other names are understood to remain under consideration.
